findings.summary: Disk exhaustion in the shared container blocked independent execution (npm ci, vitest, mutation witness); mitigated by static reading and the work history's captured probe, control arm, gates and E2E evidence.
FROZEN_NOW is TZ-dependent in principle near month end, but no assertion in this spec depends on a month-derived value; pre-existing, inert.

Roster-verdict fixtures reached via getHubPayload's argument-less call use day offsets far from the 7/28-day thresholds, so mutation sensitivity there is weak; pre-existing, out of this phase's scope.
findings.status: non-blocking, flag for a later phase
